text: Sport Qory (Fund for Support of Sport) is Kazakhstan's designated single operator for distributing off-budget money for sport, and took Barys hockey club under its management in 2021; its director-general says its main funds come from the quasi-state sector and names sovereign wealth fund Samruk-Kazyna as the fund's general partner.
short: Sport Qory is the state-designated channel for off-budget sports money; its director names Samruk-Kazyna as its general partner providing the main funds.

source.name: Sport Qory — О Фонде (About the Fund)
source.quote: Фонд является Единым оператором по распределению внебюджетных денежных средств, направленных на развитие физической культуры и спорта.
source.note: Translation: 'The Fund is the single operator for distributing off-budget funds directed at developing physical culture and sport.' The same page says Barys hockey club was placed under the Fund's management in 2021.

additionalSources.name: Vesti.kz — Sport Qory: кто спонсирует казахстанский спорт и как это работает? (interview with director-general Askhat Seisembek)
additionalSources.quote: Основные средства поступают из квазигосударственного сектора, наш генеральный партнер – Фонд национального благосостояния "Самрук-Казына".
additionalSources.note: Translation (the fund's director-general speaking): 'The main funds come from the quasi-state sector; our general partner is the Samruk-Kazyna national welfare fund.'
